about:
# GatherLog

Remembers where your characters find things, works out the best place to go for more, and guides you there. An addon for World of Warcraft: Forever (client 1.60.x).

Formerly called GatherTrail. It was renamed in 0.21.0 because another Forever addon called "Gather Trail" uses the same folder name and the same `/gt` command. Type `/glog` now.

## What it tracks

| | Recorded when you |
|---|---|
| **Ore** | mine a vein, fail to, or point at one |
| **Herbs** | pick one, fail to, or point at one |
| **Fishing pools** | point at a pool, or fish it after pointing at it |
| **Skinning spots** | skin a creature (filed under the leather it gave) |
| **Treasure chests** | open one, or point at one |
| **Rare creatures** | see one, kill and loot one, or the game marks one on the minimap |

Every character on your account adds to the same history, including characters that cannot gather: pointing at a vein with a character who has no Mining still records it, and so does walking up to one when the game highlights it for the interact key. Everything recorded is shared with all your characters (the game saves it when you log out or `/reload`).

## Using it

Click the pickaxe button on the minimap, or type `/glog` (or `/gatherlog`).

1. Pick a tab (Ore, Herbs, Fish, Skins, Chests, Rares) and, if you like, one or more types in the list.
2. The right side ranks the zones you have records in. Hover a zone to see how its score was reached.
3. Press **Start route**. An arrow shows the way to the next stop, the game's own map marker is placed on it, and the route is drawn on the world map with numbered stops.

The ranking weighs how many nodes a zone has and how often they have been there, how short a loop they make, how far away the zone is, whether it is above your level or hostile to your faction, and whether you have the skill for the nodes.

GatherLog starts empty. It has no built-in database; everything it knows, it learned from your own play.

## Getting between zones

As you play it also records flight masters (when you open a flight map), the places you walk from one zone into another, and transports such as boats. A route to another zone then comes with steps: go to this flight master, fly there, cross here.

## Options

The **Options** button in the window, or these commands:

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/glog` | Open the window |
| `/glog route` | Route through every node in the zone you are in |
| `/glog skip`, `/glog stop` | Skip to the next stop, or stop the route |
| `/glog show ore` (or `herb`, `fish`, `skin`, `chest`, `rare`) | Show or hide one kind of pin |
| `/glog mine` | Show pins only for this character's professions (the default; chests and rares always show), or for everything |
| `/glog hide` | Hide every pin on both maps, or show them again (also the **Hide pins** button, right-click on the minimap button, or a key binding) |
| `/glog pins`, `/glog minimap` | Show or hide pins on the world map or minimap |
| `/glog beacon`, `/glog sound` | The in-world marker, and the sound on reaching a stop |
| `/glog detect` | Record nodes you point at on the minimap |
| `/glog zone`, `/glog stats`, `/glog travel` | What is known about this zone, your records, and travel |
| `/glog forget` | Delete the record nearest to you |
| `/glog help` | List every command |

Export and import are on the Options page. An export is plain text you can keep as a backup or give to a friend; importing never loses anything you already have.

## What is and is not proven

Confirmed working in the game during the Forever beta:

- Mining, herbs, skinning and treasure chests, including failed attempts
- Pointing at nodes in the world and at tracking blips on the minimap
- Profession skill, zone crossings on foot, and zone levels learned from the creatures you meet
- The window, the Options page and the minimap pins

Written and tested outside the game, but not yet seen working in it:

- Fishing pools and rare creatures
- Flight masters and transports
- The marker in the world on the next stop

If one of these does not work for you, `/glog debug` prints what the game reports, which is what is needed to fix it.

## Known limits

- **English only.** Fishing pools, chests and ore blips on the minimap are recognised by English words in their names.
- **Routes are straight lines.** The addon knows where things are, not what is in the way.
- **Minimap blips are not read automatically.** The game does not tell addons where its tracking blips are, so you have to point at one for it to be recorded. Herbs are recognised by name (the classic herbs are built in; a herb new to Forever is learned the first time you pick it).
- **Combat.** The game restricts what addons may read during combat; a record that cannot be made is skipped.
- **Square minimaps** are not supported; pins assume a round one.

## Your data

Everything is saved on your own computer, in the game's saved-settings folder, as `GatherLog.lua`. Nothing is sent anywhere.

## Controller

With a game controller, the **B** button closes the GatherLog window and its data dialog, like the X and Escape do. While a window is open, B closes it; once it is closed, B goes back to whatever you have it set to. When a fight starts, B goes straight back to its usual job, even with the window open.

## More from this author

Other small addons for World of Warcraft: Forever, all free:

- **[MouseTip](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/mousetip)** shows tooltips at your mouse cursor.
- **[RangeShade](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rangeshade)** shades action buttons red when your target is out of range.
- **[JunkMate](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/junkmate)** sells junk and repairs at vendors, makes room for loot when your bags are full, and tidies your bank.
- **[AltGlance](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/altglance)** shows all your characters at a glance: level, gold, rested and where you left them.
- **[SwiftQuest](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/swiftquest)** accepts quests and hands them in as soon as you talk to the quest giver, without ever choosing a reward for you.
- **[SessionRecap](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/sessionrecap)** keeps a running tally of your play session: gold, experience per hour, quests, gathering and loot.
- **[MacroKit](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/macrokit)** adds ready-made macros for your class and spec, for all nine classes, and never overwrites your own.
- **[ZoomPad](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/zoompad)** puts big + and - buttons on screen that zoom the camera, made for the Steam Deck touchscreen.
- **[GamepadMacros](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/gamepadmacros)** adds ready-made macros for controller and Steam Deck players: heal yourself, use a quest item, save and wear gear, leave a group, emotes.
- **[FDR - Flight Data Recorder](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/fdr-flight-data-recorder)** times every flight-master flight and counts your next one down to landing.

## Installing

Install it from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/gatherlog) with the CurseForge app, or by hand: copy this folder into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\` as `GatherLog`, restart the game, and enable GatherLog on the character select screen.

## Developing

- `tools\Link-Addon.ps1` links this folder into the game's AddOns folder, so edits are live after `/reload`.
- `python tests/run.py` runs the tests (`pip install lupa` once). They run the addon in real Lua 5.1 against a fake of the game's API.
- `tools\Publish.ps1 -Message "..."` runs the tests and pushes to GitHub. GitHub runs the tests again on every push.

## Releasing

`tools\Publish.ps1 -Message "Release x.y.z" -Tag vx.y.z` publishes and tags. The tag makes GitHub package the addon and attach the zip to a GitHub release. A tag with `beta` in it, such as `v0.17.0-beta1`, is released as a beta.

To also upload to CurseForge and Wago, two things are needed once:

1. Create the project on each site, then add its ID to `GatherLog.toc`:
   `## X-Curse-Project-ID: 123456` and `## X-Wago-ID: abc123`.
2. Create an upload token on each site and add it to this repository's secrets (Settings, Secrets and variables, Actions) as `CF_API_KEY` (or `CF_KEY`) and `WAGO_API_TOKEN`.

CurseForge is set up (project 1790426); Wago is not.

Before each release: raise `## Version:` in `GatherLog.toc` and add the version to `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Licence

MIT. See `LICENSE`.

# GatherLog

## 0.21.4

- A herb or other node you couldn't gather (too low a skill, say) was noted as "(not mined)" whatever it was. It now says "(not gathered)", for every kind of node.

## 0.21.3

- **Controller:** when a fight starts, B goes straight back to its usual job, even with a GatherLog window open (it used to stay on closing the window until the fight ended). It closes the window again once the fight is over.

## 0.21.2

- **Controller:** the B button now closes GatherLog's windows, like the X and Escape. While one is open, B closes it; once it is closed, B does whatever you have it set to again.

## 0.21.1

- Fixed: the minimap button could keep following the mouse after a drag, and then move together with another addon's button sitting on top of it. It now stops the moment you let go.

## 0.21.0

- **GatherTrail is now GatherLog.** Another Forever addon on CurseForge is called "Gather Trail", installs into the same folder and also uses `/gt`, so the two could not be installed side by side. The slash command is now `/glog` (or `/gatherlog`), the folder is `GatherLog`, and the saved data is `GatherLogDB`. Nothing else changes. Entries below this one use the old name.

## 0.20.0

- Each character now sees pins only for the professions it has: ore for miners, herbs for herbalists, fishing pools for fishers, skinning spots for skinners. Chests and rares are shown to everyone, and the stops of a route you are following always show. Turn it off with the new "Only my professions' nodes" option or `/gt mine`.
- Nothing changes in what is recorded: every character still records every node it sees, points at or clicks, profession or not, and the whole account shares it. A miner logging in sees the ore your herbalist rode past.

## 0.19.0

- Hide all pins in one click, to declutter the maps: the new **Hide pins** button in the window's header, right-click on the minimap button, `/gt hide`, or a key binding (Key Bindings, AddOns, GatherTrail). Every node pin and travel marker goes from both the world map and the minimap; the same click brings them back exactly as they were. Stops on a route you are following stay visible. The minimap button's icon turns grey while pins are hidden.
- Stopping the route from the minimap button is now **Shift + right-click**.

## 0.18.2

- Every classic gathering node is now known by name: added Patch of Elemental Water (fishing) and Giant Clam (chests). All ores, herbs, fishing pools and chests from the original game are checked by the tests.

## 0.18.1

(0.18.0 was a packaging mistake: it held the same files as 0.17.3. This is the release it should have been.)

- Riding or running past nodes records every one you point at. A second node with the same name was ignored for 5 seconds, so on a mount most of a row of veins was missed. Sightings are now judged by place, as on the minimap.
- Walking up to a node records it even without the cursor on it, when the game highlights it for the interact key (soft targeting). Using a node with the interact key on a character without the profession counts as a failed attempt, as clicking it does.
- Forever's low-level herbs ("Wilted Peacebloom", "Stunted Silverleaf") are recognised from the start, on the minimap and in the world, by the classic herb name inside theirs.
- As always, what any character finds is shared with every character on the account.

## 0.17.3

- Pointing at nodes on the minimap is more reliable. Moving the cursor straight from one node to another of the same name (Peacebloom to Peacebloom) used to record only the first, because the game keeps the tooltip up with the same text the whole way; and a second node of the same name was ignored for 5 seconds. Each node is now judged by where it is, so every one is recorded, and resting on one still records it only once.
- The minimap tooltip is now checked every frame instead of ten times a second, so a quick sweep across a node is not missed.

## 0.17.2

- First release on CurseForge. No changes to the addon itself.

## 0.17.1

- Herbs are now recorded from the minimap. Pointing at a herb's minimap icon used to be ignored until that herb had been picked at least once, because a herb's name says nothing about being a herb (unlike "Copper Vein"). GatherTrail now knows the classic herb names from the start; a herb new to Forever is still learned the first time you pick it.

## 0.17.0 (beta)

First public version.

- Records ore, herbs, fishing pools, skinning spots, treasure chests and rare creatures as your characters find them, shared across the whole account.
- Learns from gathering, from failed attempts, from pointing at a node in the world or on the minimap, and from characters without the profession.
- Ranks the best zone for what you want, by how much is there, how tight a loop it makes, how far away it is, your level, your faction and your profession skill.
- Guides you there: an arrow, a marker in the world, numbered stops on the world map and pins on the minimap.
- Learns flight masters, zone crossings and transports as you travel, and plans trips over them.
- Options page, pin filters, export and import.

- Riding or running past nodes records every one you point at. A second node with the same name was ignored for 5 seconds, so on a mount most of a row of veins was missed. Sightings are now judged by place, as on the minimap.
- Walking up to a node records it even without the cursor on it, when the game highlights it for the interact key (soft targeting). Using a node with the interact key on a character without the profession counts as a failed attempt, as clicking it does.
- Forever's low-level herbs ("Wilted Peacebloom", "Stunted Silverleaf") are recognised from the start, on the minimap and in the world, by the classic herb name inside theirs.
- As always, what any character finds is shared with every character on the account.

## 0.17.3

- Pointing at nodes on the minimap is more reliable. Moving the cursor straight from one node to another of the same name (Peacebloom to Peacebloom) used to record only the first, because the game keeps the tooltip up with the same text the whole way; and a second node of the same name was ignored for 5 seconds. Each node is now judged by where it is, so every one is recorded, and resting on one still records it only once.
- The minimap tooltip is now checked every frame instead of ten times a second, so a quick sweep across a node is not missed.

## 0.17.2

- First release on CurseForge. No changes to the addon itself.

## 0.17.1

- Herbs are now recorded from the minimap. Pointing at a herb's minimap icon used to be ignored until that herb had been picked at least once, because a herb's name says nothing about being a herb (unlike "Copper Vein"). GatherTrail now knows the classic herb names from the start; a herb new to Forever is still learned the first time you pick it.

## 0.17.0 (beta)

First public version.

- Records ore, herbs, fishing pools, skinning spots, treasure chests and rare creatures as your characters find them, shared across the whole account.
- Learns from gathering, from failed attempts, from pointing at a node in the world or on the minimap, and from characters without the profession.
- Ranks the best zone for what you want, by how much is there, how tight a loop it makes, how far away it is, your level, your faction and your profession skill.
- Guides you there: an arrow, a marker in the world, numbered stops on the world map and pins on the minimap.
- Learns flight masters, zone crossings and transports as you travel, and plans trips over them.
- Options page, pin filters, export and import.
